title: Caledonia Aquatic Center opens online registration for swim lessons and pool passes
text:
Caledonia Aquatic Center opens online registration for swim lessons and pool passes
The Caledonia Aquatic Center announced on June 24 that it is now accepting online signups for swim lessons, pool passes, and pool parties. Interested patrons are required to create a PoolPassPro account, which will be used to collect emergency contact and family information.
The aquatic center is offering all levels of swim lessons across two sessions. Additional sessions may be scheduled if there is sufficient demand. Registration for these programs must be completed online through the PoolPassPro platform.
At this time, the center is not processing payments online. Payments by cash or check can be made at City Hall or directly at the aquatic center before participating in any activities.
Further information about registration procedures and access to the PoolPassPro website can be found on the city's official website.
